_doc: Ordinary notes and documents for the no-model reader (daemon/src/extract/general.rs).
Each case pairs a passage with the sentences a person would pick out as stating something
specific and checkable: a fact, number, date, decision, plan, commitment or preference.
Greetings, thanks, questions, requests, headings and vague opinions are not expected, and
cases with an empty list are passages that should yield nothing. The sets were written one
after another as the reader was built, so they are regression sets, not blind tests;
the last two (blind, blind2) were each held out when first used.
